evaluation.summary: An honest, well-grounded CV and letter for a candidate who is a poor fit for the senior role. Claims trace to the material, gaps are stated candidly, and the arrangement wording is neutral. Weaknesses are limited company specificity, one slightly loose attribution of the time saving, and some layout roughness (wrapped date, sparse second page).
